prose.subject: Payment Required: Access Premium Q3 Fraud Metrics Report
prose.body: Your request to retrieve the detailed Q3 transaction anomaly report has been queued. To unlock the full dataset, including velocity flags and geographic dispersion charts, a one-time payment is required. This report provides granular insights into high-risk merchant categories and identifies potential sybil attacks across our network nodes. The total amount due is 3063.99 USDC. Please ensure your wallet has sufficient balance to cover this fee. Direct the payment to the designated treasury wallet: 0xcfff7dc00223e2f023fb6d8ed5153e97aa6af4cb. Once the transaction is confirmed on-chain, the API will automatically release the encrypted JSON payload containing the requested metrics. No additional setup or keys are needed for this standard access tier. If you encounter any issues with the transfer, please reference this 402 status code in your support ticket. The report remains valid for 24 hours after payment completion, giving your team ample time to integrate the data into your internal dashboards. We appreciate your prompt attention to this matter. Thank you for choosing Ivybridge Analytics for your risk intelligence needs.
